touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Tong qualifies as a local detour through Church of St Bartholomew and Tong Infirmary. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Tong: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Tong offers Church of St Bartholomew, Tong Infirmary, Churchyard cross, St Bartholomew's Church within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Church of St Bartholomew
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Church of St Bartholomew and Tong Infirmary, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
